summary: Build practical internal auditing and control testing skills with COSO, ISO 19011, audit tools, and reporting exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Internal auditing helps professionals assess whether controls address risks and operate consistently. This training is for internal auditors, control managers, compliance officers, and risk analysts who need a structured approach to audit work. It covers risk-based planning, mapping risks to controls, designing tests and evaluating evidence, then assessing deficiencies and reporting prioritized corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who perform, supervise, or rely on internal auditing and control assurance in operational, financial, technology, and compliance environments. It suits intermediate practitioners who can work with business processes and control documentation and now need a more consistent risk-based audit method.
modules: Findings, Root Causes, and Control Deficiencies
Audit Quality, Integration, and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to business processes, risk registers, control descriptions, or compliance activities. Prior internal audit experience is useful but not required. No coding or programming is required. Advanced technology topics, including AI-assisted exception analysis and continuous auditing, are covered at conceptual and operational application level rather than technical engineering level.
